llm_judge_reasons: Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree address bar, which always reflects the currently loaded page.
goto_prefix='' is semantically correct for chrome:// scheme URLs — prevents incorrect prepending of 'https://' that would corrupt the URL.
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) receives rules={'expected': ['chrome://version']} directly (correct for type='rule') and applies re.search on the URL string.
Pattern 'chrome://version' contains no problematic regex metacharacters and unambiguously matches only the Chrome version info page URL.
Instruction has a single requirement (navigate to chrome://version) and the evaluator checks exactly that — coverage is complete.
Initial New Tab state (chrome://newtab) does not match the pattern, satisfying negative-control resistance.
No postconfig needed: URL is always accessible via the address bar regardless of page content or dialog state.
